summary: The live Tokens API supports create/get/list/stats/revoke with coherent positive and negative behavior, but the documented verify surface is not available as described. A fresh backend session was minted from the saved Privy token, a real access token was created and revoked successfully, invalid scope and credential combinations were rejected correctly, and invalid bearer tokens returned 401. The overall claim fails because POST /api/v1/tokens/verify did not function as the documented public verify endpoint in live.
contract_findings: Live POST /api/v1/tokens requires credential_ids in addition to scopes and expires_in.
Live dashboard-issued tokens only allow the credential:read scope.
POST /api/v1/tokens/verify did not behave as a public verify endpoint in live; the response was 401 and the Allow header advertised GET,HEAD.
